Thanks again for running the test harness with our SE team last week. We have consolidated the initial numbers and would like to do a 45-60 minute readout for your engineering, security, and procurement stakeholders to:

- Walk through the latency/throughput curves and failure modes we saw at scale
- Highlight configuration changes (batching/kv cache) that improved tail latency

Can you share 2–3 windows over the next week that work for the FinCo ENG + Security + Procurement folks? We want Rishi (SE) to demo the trace and Monica (CS) to cover runbook/operational handoffs.

I attached a short summary and a proposed runbook outline to make the meeting faster. If procurement needs a separate PO / commercial hookup we can loop in Laura.
